about: How each trigger is read. Main route: every frame the mod polls GetActionValue(<game action>) on the locomotion script interface, so inputs follow the player's own key/pad bindings with no setup. Backup: Observe(PlayerPuppet.OnAction). Last resort: optional CET registerInput bindings. A route is used per action only once it has produced a reading. One row = INPUTS.<id>.

cet_input_id.about: registerInput id (player may bind it in the CET overlay; optional)

default_keys.about: What the player presses with default game bindings

rows.default_keys: Hold Space / A (Xbox) / Cross (PS) while in the air
rows.evidence: Read by polling GetActionValue on the locomotion script interface (main route), with PlayerPuppet.OnAction as backup. Action names: 'Jump' from psiberx gist 0e94bc93 and Vault Anywhere; release = value back to 0
